mentions.name: Golden Speaker
mentions.description: A speech-processing technology that generates a personalized "Golden Speaker" for each user: the user records a sentence (a phonetic pangram), and the system preserves their accent and voice identity while correcting their pronunciation, delivered as a TTS system or real-time accent conversion. It aims to help users adopt a native-like accent faster and is currently open as a waitlist.
mentions.problem: Current speech-processing and voice conversion approaches lose the user's voice identity, and adopting a native-like accent is slow.
mentions.audience: Users who want to adopt a native-like accent faster.
mentions.source_excerpt: We generate a "Golden Speaker" for you -> You record yourself saying a sentence (a phonetic pangram), we keep your accent which represents your voice identity but we correct your pronunciation and then you have a Golden Speaker system. This may be in the form of a TTS or a real-time accent conversion technology.
